strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Where am I...? Oh, right... I...
Well, here I am! Show yourself!
Isn't it rude to keep a guest waiting?
Hey, it's not you guys
I'm calling for. I want that red one and the little miss to come out.
No small talk either, huh?
...Well then, until they show up, I'll kill some time with you guys...!
Wow! The whole gang's here~... Guess this isn't the time for jokes.
And now you're giving me the silent treatment again?
Look, you're always saying weird stuff, so why so quiet now?
Raring to go, huh? Then I'll play along!
Okaaay, even more of you~!
Seriously, what's the idea!
If you're coming out, come out all at once!
Ah~ Kidding, kidding! It was a joke! Don't take it seriously, 'kay?
(Still, bones first, then plants... So next comes armor, I bet.
Stronger ones are showing up bit by bit... So what comes last?)
Okay, okay, the exit's that way~. ...Well, right on schedule.
I'd like a surprise, you know, a surprise.
(That's all that's been confirmed so far. What shows up next?
The little miss... probably.)
Maybe you were told to keep quiet, but women hate being bored!
If you're not in the mood to chat... then come at me!
Here you come again!
Keep pestering me and I'll reach in all over
and rattle your back teeth loose!
R-Reach in where...!?
No, Captain, that's not the part to question.
Hey, shouldn't we just shoot that?
Yeah, she's messing with us.
Oops. Ah, ahaha, it was the Ra Cailum. Hi, everyone, how've you been?
You idiot! Running off on your own! What the hell were you thinking!
No kidding. ...Still, we'll have to ask about that later.
Exactly. And on top of that, she suddenly picks a fight with us.
But...
Discipline can wait. Wipe out the unknown enemy! All units, launch!
Wow... So I am getting disciplined...
Still, these guys again?
Excellen, you sure you're not secretly in league with them?
Don't go casually saying such problematic things!
It's like I got invited, or... I just kind of wandered all the way here.
(As I thought, there's something about Excellen Browning
and Kyosuke Nanbu down on Earth...)
No time for chitchat, Judau. There's a fair number of them.
We'll just have to attack.
Hmm, if we knew anything about what they are, we could plan a fight...
At least against the ones that shoot beams from their eyes,
the Distortion Field works great!
That's got nothing to do with what they are.
Careful, everyone! I bet... after this, their ace in the hole will show up!
Ace in the hole...? You mean the enemy's main force?
Browning, how do you know that?
Well, they've been coming out in order this whole time.
(And for a while now, I've felt like someone's watching me... Probably...)
Enemy reinforcements!?
No way... That's...!?
What the? I've never seen that before!
A new enemy model!?
It's... not in our data. The Lieutenant may be right!
Ruri!?
No data on the enemy.
So it really is... a new enemy robot!?
Heh, so what! Even if they've beefed it up some...
Wait, Kappei! Haven't we... seen that somewhere before!?
Yeah, that shape... But it's gotta be a coincidence, right?
Kyosuke's!?
That's it! If I remember right...
...It's the Alteisen.
You're correct.
...I knew it... It's you.
Tch, I see. So this is their ace in the hole.
So it's their boss!
I see, the whole lineup's here. With a new model thrown in as a bonus.
What are you up to!?
Making a fake Alteisen... What's your angle!?
...Kyosuke.
When I think of him... my chest... feels all hazy...
Excuse me!?
But... I don't know him...
In the end... all I can make is his shell.
(This girl... is creating the enemies... these bone things...!?)
Ugh... What is this... feeling...? Excellen! Are you all right!?
What's wrong? Here they come...!
Huh!? What this girl's been saying... the others can't hear it...!?
Yes, and Kyosuke... can't talk like this either...
But with you, I can.
...That's exactly why I need you, Excellen. You, only you...
Geez! Stop saying things that make no sense!
You, me, and Kyosuke... I don't know how we're connected,
but if you're an enemy I have to defeat... I won't hold back!
...Excellen, I still... you...
...Excellen, I still... you...
She got away... And there's no sign of the others either.
Confirmed withdrawal of all enemy forces... Looks like we're safe.
Phew, guess we can relax for now.
(That girl... Why is she so fixated on Kyosuke and me?
And... she only spoke to me, one-sidedly.
...That's exactly why she needs me...? I don't get it at all.)
Browning! Respond, Browning!
Huh? Ah, yes!
Explain yourself. Why you rushed off, and why you were surrounded here.
We were worried, you know?
...How should I put it... I sensed the enemy, sort of...
Hey, hey, that's no kind of reason...
You rushed off for a reason like that?
If we'd been late, what were you going to do against that many?
Hey, hang on.
...I kinda get it, though. Times like that, you know?
...It's true. When you get a sort of... bad feeling...
That's it! Kind of a Newtype thing, or a Psychic Slash thing...
(Her connection with that enemy. It may be related to that accident.
...I can't say for sure, though...)
Or she's just picking up some signal, y'know.
Um, don't forget Pai's supposed to be psychic too, okay?
Very well.
...You'll be confined to the brig until we reach the next point.
We are a military unit, after all.
...Understood.
Wow, so strict. The Nadesico's so easygoing about that stuff!
Well, if we were that strict, you'd never get out of the brig, Captain.
Might not be a bad idea.
No comment.
Wh-What's that supposed to mean...!?
(Still... why does that little miss keep going on about Kyosuke?
A love rival...? A dangerous one, then. And only I can hear her voice...)
